coordinates.source: neuPrint somaLocation (hemibrain v1.2.1 voxel coordinates, 8 nm)
coordinates.normalized: xyz = (soma - center) * scale → longest axis in [-1, 1], isotropic
coordinates.fallback: soma null (139 of 907 sampled): mean soma of the same primary ROI + seeded jitter ±3% of extent; global mean if the ROI has no soma
